title: Write-path closure audit (static AST/regex)
premise_under_test: The V1 perturbation operator is RANK-2: between brain construction and brain.run(), run_single mutates the brain ONLY via apply_genotype + apply_anesthetic, and every such mutation is a UNIFORM broadcast (identical value to all N neurons for I_ext; a single global scalar for synapse weight w). No per-neuron-VARYING reachable writer exists. QF = G(total_pa, snare_gain).

definitions.writer: Any AST assignment (Assign/AugAssign) or in-place mutation whose target is an attribute/subscript chain ending in one of the coupling tokens on a brain/neurons/synapse/PoissonGroup object; OR a PoissonGroup(...) construction with a rates= kwarg.
definitions.per_neuron_VARYING: A write whose RHS value is NOT identical across all N neurons: indexed assignment with a per-index array/vector RHS (e.g. neurons.I_ext_ = ablation_current_pA*1e-12 where ablation_current_pA is a length-N vector), or a subscript write to a strict subset of indices with non-uniform values.
definitions.uniform_broadcast: A write whose RHS is a single scalar applied identically to all targeted neurons (e.g. I_ext[:] += scalar*pA), or a single global multiplicative scalar on the entire weight vector (w[:] *= factor).
definitions.rank_contributing: A writer that is (a) reachable from run_single along the construction->run() window AND (b) actually changes the realized I_ext/w/rates seen by brain.run().
definitions.reachable_from_run_single: There exists a call-graph path from run_single() to the function containing the writer, traversed ONLY through calls that run_single makes between brain construction and brain.run() (i.e. apply_genotype, apply_anesthetic, and brain-factory constructors). Functions only invoked by ablate()/set_proprioception()/set_sensory_rate()/inject_poisson()/modulation attach are NOT reachable unless run_single calls them.
definitions.dormant_attached_but_rate_gated_zero: A writer that IS added to the Brian2 network at construction (so it executes during run) but whose effect is gated to zero because its rate/current source is never updated above zero by run_single (e.g. proprio_group created with rates=0 and set_proprioception never called).

G1-closure.criterion: The set of {reachable-from-run_single AND rank-contributing} writers == exactly {apply_genotype, apply_anesthetic}, with ZERO per-neuron-VARYING writes among them, verified for ALL THREE factories (worm, fly, mouse).
G1-closure.decision_rule: PASS iff (reachable_rank_contributing_writer_functions == {apply_genotype, apply_anesthetic}) AND (count of per_neuron_VARYING writers that are reachable+rank_contributing == 0) AND (this holds for worm AND fly AND mouse). Any reachable per-neuron-VARYING rank-contributing writer => FAIL => rank-2 premise broken => HALT.

G2-rot-detector.criterion: The machine-re-derived writer seed-set (every coupling-token writer site the AST/regex pass finds) is a SUPERSET of the >=11 hand-enumerated known witnesses.
G2-rot-detector.decision_rule: PASS iff re-derived_writer_site_count >= 11 AND re-derived set contains (by file:line or function tag) every hand-enumerated witness above. Missing any witness => FAIL (audit blind spot).

G3-rate-source-durability.criterion: Regression lock asserts BOTH: (A) no NEW I_ext/I_ext_ writer beyond {apply_genotype, apply_anesthetic} is reachable+rank-contributing from run_single; AND (B) every PoissonGroup.rates source (proprioceptive/sensory) is either unreachable from run_single OR reachable-but-rate-gated-zero (never driven >0 by run_single).
G3-rate-source-durability.decision_rule: PASS iff clause_A (reachable_new_Iext_writers == 0) AND clause_B (every rate source classified UNREACHABLE or ATTACHED-RATE-GATED-ZERO; none ACTIVE). Either clause false => FAIL.

overall_decision_rule: G1-closure, G2-rot-detector, G3-rate-source-durability are ALL hard. Any FAIL => P18-A FAIL => HALT the build program (re-scope operator rank). No PARTIAL reframing.
anti_target_engineering: Thresholds (witness_count>=11, per_neuron_varying_reachable==0) are fixed here BEFORE running. The audit is accept-either-way: a reachable per-neuron-VARYING writer is a real, publishable FAIL that REVIVES some positive claims.
